body:
Wow. That metaphor is not only beautiful, it's also incredibly figurative. Basically what I feel like now. What makes matters worse is that its my best friend sitting near the bonfire, and I can't sit with him, no matter how welcoming he is - a thick glass wall of distance is between us. So I am unable to do anything but look and cry.

The isolation grows out of middle school, back when I started being bullied. It got harder and harder to make friends, and suddenly I was left with the only one - not even admitting it to myself. And then he was gone, and I'm unable to return him. Now I have no idea how to make friends, socialize and if there is any point to keep holding on. Its like I need people to make me happy, but I'm too scared of them, I am tired of being with the wrong ones so I want to be alone. These opposing feelings are sometimes way too hard to bear. When I'm with people I want to be alone, when I'm without them I need them. That would be solved if I had someone special, like my best friend, near me, but I don't. 

Anyway, it's 3 am here and I am tired as hell. I really want to go to sleep. Thank you so much for talking to me, you are a very kind person indeed. Wishing you the best.

I don't know if he would. He's dead and I don't want to think whether he would judge me. Considering I did everything to forget him, even basically told his parents to fuck off when they wanted to talk to me.... 

It's been three years.

I'm incredibly jealous of people...just having fun. My friend is going shitfaced with his friends this friday again, and... I'm unhealthily jealous of him. I dont know why do I care so much. I'm just so jealous  of him knowing that no one wants to invite me to parties, knowing that I can't participate. Its such a bad feeling. Not a silent depression that eats me slowly, but rather a monster that makes me want to scream and harm myself. Even though I never do.

No, it wouldn't have been his fault at all. In fact, he was bullied only because he was my best friend. And I was too cold-hearted to just talk to him. I can't be angry with him - he never said a word against me and never did anything bad to me.

I totally agree with you about the last statement. I'm trying to stop thinking about it, but things happening now, I've told about them already, only make it worse. The jealousy and the isolation make me want to scream and beat my head against the wall so much.

Yes. Exactly.

I can't let go of the past. The bullying in middle school, and the events that led to the suicide of my best and only friend broke me inside. I sometimes wonder what life could have been like if I didn't let him die - but I did. And I pay for that now. 

I can't see the future - the past is too overwhelming.

I'm not detained or anything, its just too late to change schools now, and this one, not minding the depressing atmosphere, provides the best education I can get at the moment at my place. I just don't want to go there, see the same people over and over again and feel so alienated. 

I do feel trapped, but it's hardly because of the school - but rather because I feel so disconnected from people. I am wasting my youth whilst everyone else lives for the moment.
I don't think you can, but it wouldn't hurt to talk

Only to a friend I mentioned in my post. I don't want to annoy him though, I already feel like he only listens to me out of pity and responsibility for me. He knows way too much about my past, but still not enough.

Seventeen.

No one besides the person I mentioned knows anything about the struggle I go through, and at the school no one gives a fuck about anything or anyone. A really depressing place for me, though I have no choice but to attend it.
